statement:
∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (R M : ℝ) (n : ℕ),
  0 < R →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f (closedBall c R) →
      (∀ z ∈ sphere c R, ‖f z‖ ≤ M) → ‖iteratedDeriv n f c‖ ≤ ↑n.factorial * M / R ^ n

universal.type: ∀ z ∈ sphere c R, ‖f z‖ ≤ M
universal.name: hM
